title: Design System: WhatsApp for Home Assistant

small.purpose: Status, dates, help, and secondary metadata.

motion.name: button-color-transition
motion.purpose: Button feedback when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.html: <button class="ds-button-primary" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3h4l2 5-3 2a15 15 0 0 0 5 5l2-3 5 2v4a3 3 0 0 1-3 3C10 20 4 14 3 6a3 3 0 0 1 3-3Z"/></svg>Call</button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary{color-scheme:light dark;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);border-radius:8px;background:light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);color:light-dark(#ffffff, #102d22);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font:500 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button-primary:hover{filter:brightness(.94);}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-primary{transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{color-scheme:light dark;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);border-radius:8px;background:light-dark(#ffffff, #1c2428);color:light-dark(#21312d, #e7eeeb);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font:500 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:light-dark(#eef2f0, #2a3630);}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-secondary{transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Hang up or request a confirmed recovery reset.
components.html: <button class="ds-button-danger" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" width="18" height="18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 15c5-6 13-6 18 0v4h-5v-3H8v3H3z"/></svg>Hang up</button>
components.css: .ds-button-danger{color-scheme:light dark;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:light-dark(#fbecee, #492b2d);color:light-dark(#b03a3b, #ffb0ad);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;font:500 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button-danger:hover{background:light-dark(#eef2f0, #2a3630);}.ds-button-danger:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-button-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button-danger{transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Recipient Field
components.description: A labeled recipient field with visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Recipient<input class="ds-input" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Phone number or WhatsApp ID"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{color-scheme:light dark;display:grid;gap:7px;color:light-dark(#21312d, #e7eeeb);font:500 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;}.ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;border:1px solid light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);background:light-dark(#ffffff, #1c2428);color:light-dark(#21312d, #e7eeeb);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;font:14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;caret-color:light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);}.ds-input::placeholder{color:light-dark(#62716d, #acbcb6);opacity:1;}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Task Navigation
components.description: Current task uses an accent underline and text.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Account views"><button class="ds-tab" aria-current="page">Connection</button><button class="ds-tab">Calls</button><button class="ds-tab">Recordings</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs{color-scheme:light dark;display:flex;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);}.ds-tab{position:relative;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0 0 12px;color:light-dark(#62716d, #acbcb6);font:13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-tab[aria-current="page"]{color:light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);font-weight:600;}.ds-tab[aria-current="page"]::after{position:absolute;height:2px;background:light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);bottom:-1px;left:0;right:0;content:"";}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-tab{min-height:44px;}}

components.name: Account Source
components.description: A selected account retains identity and connection state.
components.css: .ds-account{color-scheme:light dark;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:left;width:100%;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 10px;background:transparent;color:light-dark(#21312d, #e7eeeb);font:14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-account:hover{background:light-dark(#eef2f0, #2a3630);}.ds-account[aria-pressed="true"]{background:light-dark(#e8f3ee, #273f34);border-color:light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);}.ds-avatar{display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);border-radius:50%;background:light-dark(#ffffff, #1c2428);font-weight:600;color:light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);}.ds-account-name{display:block;font-weight:600;}.ds-account-state{display:block;font-size:12px;color:light-dark(#62716d, #acbcb6);}.ds-account:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Active Call Strip
components.description: The owning account and Hang up remain available across navigation.
components.html:
In call

Calling account
components.css: .ds-live{color-scheme:light dark;position:sticky;top:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:light-dark(#e8f3ee, #273f34);color:light-dark(#21312d, #e7eeeb);padding:12px 14px;border-radius:10px;font:14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;}.ds-live-info{flex:1;min-width:130px;}.ds-live strong{font-weight:600;font-size:13px;}.ds-live p{margin:0;color:light-dark(#62716d, #acbcb6);font-size:12px;}.ds-live-hangup{min-height:34px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;background:light-dark(#fbecee, #492b2d);color:light-dark(#b03a3b, #ffb0ad);font:500 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-live-hangup:hover{background:light-dark(#eef2f0, #2a3630);}.ds-live-hangup:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Recording Row
components.description: Saved audio uses a divided metadata row and browser-native controls.

components.css: .ds-recording{color-scheme:light dark;border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);color:light-dark(#21312d, #e7eeeb);font:14px/1.5 "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;}.ds-recording-row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:13px 0;}.ds-play{width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid light-dark(#e0e7e3, #35433d);background:light-dark(#ffffff, #1c2428);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:8px;color:light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);cursor:pointer;}.ds-play:hover{background:light-dark(#e8f3ee, #273f34);}.ds-play svg{width:15px;height:15px;}.ds-recording-name{flex:1;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}.ds-recording-name small{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:light-dark(#62716d, #acbcb6);}.ds-recording-length{font-size:12px;color:light-dark(#62716d, #acbcb6);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-audio{display:block;width:100%;margin:0 0 10px;}.ds-play:focus-visible{outline:2px solid light-dark(#176b50, #89d6b5);outline-offset:3px;}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-play{width:44px;height:44px;}}

narrative.overview: A restrained communications interface makes account identity, connection health, and audio tasks easy to scan. Cool neutral surfaces, a forest-green accent, slim dividers, and the platform UI sans give connection controls and saved media one consistent language.
keyCharacteristics: Account identity stays separate from the selected task.
Compact forms and timed media rows carry useful content.
Light and dark appearances retain the same hierarchy and density.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: Keep action, selection, warning, and danger roles consistent in both appearances.

rules.name: The Task Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Account and section headings lead; status, capability, and time metadata remain supporting information.

dos: Do preserve the same type hierarchy and semantic colors in light and dark appearances.
Do reflow forms and media rows at narrow widths.
Do retain visible focus and text labels alongside state color.
donts: Don't add shadows to flat workspace panels.
Don't use the accent role for errors or destructive actions.
Don't replace native audio controls with an imitation player.
